exposure: Combined intrapartum ultrasound with free maternal positions
outcome: Duration of the first stage of labor
Duration of the second stage of labor
Cesarean section rates due to failed progression
cohort: The study included 176 women with abnormal labor progression who attempted vaginal delivery between June 2021 and May 2022.
finding: Combining intrapartum ultrasound with free maternal positions significantly reduced labor durations, cesarean section rates due to failed progression, postpartum hemorrhage, and hospital stays.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean sections due to failed progression was significantly lower in the group receiving combined intrapartum ultrasound with free maternal positions.
